name: Punk Protocol pool re-initialization
summary: The three Punk CompoundModel pools exposed initialize() without access control or a one-time initialization guard. The extraction contract reinitialized each pool with itself as forge_, invested the pool's stablecoins into Compound, and called withdrawToForge() to redeem and sweep the funds.

loss.notes: Gross victim depletion is the three exact pool outflows in the anchor transaction: 2,995,824.696852 USDC + 3,000,022.7862 USDT + 2,954,191.544042759328963399 DAI = $8,950,039.027094759 at stablecoin par. The frontrun anchor split the proceeds: its copied payload forwarded the full USDC leg to the original attacker EOA 0x1d5a5640 (hardcoded recipient in the copied calldata), while the USDT and DAI legs went to the frontrunner EOA 0x3aa27ab. The frontrunner later returned 3,000,058.381173 USDT and 1,954,191.5440427593 DAI ($4,954,249.925 total, matching Punk's reported approximately $4,954,250 recovery) to Punk deployer 0xe36cc043 and moved 1,000,000 DAI to 0xc176761d; the attacker swapped the USDC via 1inch and deposited it into Tornado Cash. Recoveries are not subtracted from gross loss.

ageReset.description: Top-level deployment of the direct USDC CompoundModel runtime; its deployment-block and pre-exploit hashes match.

sources.note: Re-anchored from transaction 0x7604c7dd6e9bcdba8bac277f1f8e7c1e4c6bb57afd4ddf6a16f629e8495a0281 at index 52 to the frontrunning loss-bearing transaction at index 50 in the same block. The seed row's transaction repeats the defect after the pools have been drained and receives only 0.028802 USDC, 0.036879 USDT, and 0.030390567272501362 DAI. The selected transaction calls initialize(address,address,address,address,address,address), invest(), and withdrawToForge(uint256) on each of the USDC, USDT, and DAI CompoundModel pools and transfers exactly 2,995,824.696852 USDC, 3,000,022.7862 USDT, and 2,954,191.544042759328963399 DAI to extraction contract 0x00000000b2ff98680adaf8a3e382176bbfc34c8f. All three pools are direct top-level deployments by 0xe36cc0432619247ab12f1cdd19bb3e7a24a7f47c, share the same 6,097-byte runtime and hash 0xad4296ca86f0d86547eee00e3723dbbd3a2c3462c846dd5dcd5b4ce9773625ce at deployment and immediately before the exploit, and execute without proxy delegation. The structured target uses the USDC pool as the representative execution context because the three pools contain the same code artifact and failure mode.

Independent full re-verification of anchor, root cause, targets, age history, and loss. Anchor: block 12995895 (timestamp 1628578498) holds exactly two defect-executing transactions; the selected transaction at index 50 is frontrunner EOA 0x3aa27ab calling generalized-frontrunner contract 0x00000000b2ff (deployed by the same EOA at block 12956897, long active against unrelated targets), and the attacker's own transaction at index 52 is EOA 0x1d5a5640 calling exploit contract 0x1695ce70 (deployed by that EOA at block 12994067) against pools already emptied two positions earlier, sweeping only 0.028802 USDC, 0.036879 USDT, and 0.030390567272501362 DAI. The attacker EOA has no earlier transaction than the exploit-contract deployment, and each pool's complete pre-exploit transaction history is exactly two entries: creation and one initialize (0xcc2a9a5b) from Punk deployer 0xe36cc043 (USDC pool blocks 12944792/12944942, USDT 12944975/12945001, DAI 12944786/12944937), so index 50 is the earliest transaction ever to exercise the defect adversarially and the earliest successful exploit of the campaign. The callTracer trace of the anchor shows initialize(address,address,address,address,address,address), invest() (0xe8b5e51f), and withdrawToForge(uint256) (0x7b9967a5) executed in that order on the USDC pool 0x3bc6aa2d first, then the USDT pool 0x1f3b04c8, then the DAI pool 0x929cb860, with initialize forge_ = 0x00000000b2ff itself, confirming the USDC pool as the representative first-reached sibling and all three executionAddresses present in the anchor trace. Root cause confirmed against BscScan-style Etherscan verified source: CompoundModel.initialize is public with no access control and no initialized guard and calls setForge(forge_), so any caller can redirect the withdrawal destination; the same-block copy by the frontrunner exercises the identical defect against the identical contracts and is scoped as one coherent exploitation event carrying the whole loss, with both takers in attackerAddresses. Targets: all three pools are direct top-level CREATE deployments by 0xe36cc043 sharing the identical 6,097-byte runtime hashing to 0xad4296ca86f0d86547eee00e3723dbbd3a2c3462c846dd5dcd5b4ce9773625ce at deployment and at block 12995894 immediately before the exploit; an opcode scan of the runtime finds no DELEGATECALL or CALLCODE, and the single SELFDESTRUCT byte at offset 6072 lies inside the trailing 51-byte CBOR metadata (code region ends at 6044), so the pools execute their own unchanged code and deployment is the correct age basis: 1628578498 - 1627891400 = 687098 seconds. The team's own initialize at block 12944942 wrote configuration the code applies as designed and at which the code is still vulnerable to re-initialization, so it is not an age reset; the exploit's own forge_ write is attacker-installed state attributed to the attack, never an age or target basis. Loss: the anchor receipt's three pool outflows to 0x00000000b2ff total $8,950,039.027094759 at par; inside the same receipt the copied payload forwards the 2,995,824.696852 USDC leg to attacker EOA 0x1d5a5640 while USDT and DAI go to the frontrunner EOA, establishing the reported approximately-$3M-attacker / approximately-$5.95M-frontrunner split onchain. Post-incident distribution verified in source-8: 1,000,000 DAI to 0xc176761d at block 12999319, then 3,000,058.381173 USDT and 1,954,191.5440427593 DAI returned to Punk deployer 0xe36cc043 at blocks 12999327 and 12999334, summing to the $4,954,249.925 recovery Punk reported; the attacker routed the USDC through 1inch and eleven Tornado Cash deposits from block 12996022. Prior review-note claims in source-3 reproduced without discrepancy.

limitations: The gross stablecoin loss is valued at par. The frontrunner returned $4,954,249.925 in USDT and DAI to the Punk deployer after the extraction (source-8); recovery is not subtracted from the gross incident amount.

notes: The seed row's anchor was a copied exploit transaction two positions after the successful frontrun. This record uses the earlier transaction that executes the same defect and carries the reported loss.
